messages:
Rina: Heads-up — onboarding QA hit a weird embed/rerank failure on staging. Not dim conflict this time, looks like an extra trailing null float creeping in from the Python helper.
Aaron: hmm can you paste logs?
Rina: Error from /rerank: 422 Unprocessable Entity "bad embedding shape: values length 1025, expected 1024".
Priya: 1025? That's an odd size. What do SDKs send?
Rina: Captured payload (sanitized): {"embedding": {"values": [0.12, 0.03, ..., 0.01, null]}} — the Python sample appended null at the end when an optional metadata field was present during JSON encoding.
Aaron: Null in numeric array — JSON lib variant? Some json.dumps options convert numpy.nan -> null. Are we accidentally injecting np.nan somewhere in preproc?
Rina: Sampleapp uses a small postprocess that concatenates a per-item bias array: bias = np.array([0.001]) when condition met, then np.concatenate([vec, bias]). When bias is empty sometimes it's a masked array which becomes object dtype and json encoder emits null.
Priya: Go batcher uses []float32 and never emits nulls so it was passing at 1024, but Python produced 1025 with null -> server validated length and rejected.
logan-bot: flake detected: sampleapp-python/runner: test_embed_shape failed (1/10 runs) due to masked bias path.
Aaron: Is there a retry in play? Could a retry send different shape?
Rina: Yes — auth refresh kicks in sometimes. We saw sequence: original POST (401) -> token refresh -> identical body retried. The first POST contained the masked array (null) only when bias condition triggered; the retry used the same mutated payload. So retry didn't change shape.
Priya: Two things to do: 1) quick fix for sampleapp - always coerce embeddings to native numeric array and drop NaNs before serializing. 2) server-side: reject arrays containing non-numeric entries earlier with a clearer error: "embedding values must be numeric; found null at index N". Also normalize by computing len(values) and using that for shape checks.
Aaron: Agreed. Add an SDK lint rule to catch object-dtype numpy arrays when serializing embeddings. We'll add a small preflight check in python-sdk: `if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating): raise ValueError('embedding must be float array')` and `arr = np.nan_to_num(arr)` before send.
Rina: I'll push a hotfix to sampleapp and a small unit test that produces masked bias path to avoid regressions.
ci-bot: Created ticket INF-4201: "python sdk/ sampleapp - masked arrays -> null in embeddings" and queued patch job.
Priya: Also audit server JSON parsing to reject non-number tokens in numeric arrays and return 400 + index hint. That will save a lot of developer time.
Aaron: For DX, add a short doc blurb in DX guide: "Embeddings must be numeric vectors. Avoid object dtype or masked numpy arrays. Use np.asarray(..., dtype=np.float32) and np.nan_to_num."
Rina: Thanks — will open PRs. Leaving repro and curl for the bug in the sampleapp issue if anyone wants to pair.
Priya: Nice catch — surprised this wasn't caught earlier by our e2e since masked bias is rare. We'll add fuzzing for scalar concatenations.
Rina: Marking this as high priority for onboarding sampleapp; patching now. :thumbsup:
